name: 工业警戒
description: 工业警示标语感：深灰 #1F1F1F 底 + 警示橙 #FF6B00 + Inter Bold。H1 超大 Black 粗体+橙底+斜纹警戒条感、H2 橙字+左黄黑斜条、p 浅灰、blockquote 橙框警示牌感、hr 黄黑斜纹条。建筑工地/工厂警戒感（vs brutalism 纯黑派，vs terminal 荧光派）。适合硬核测评/行业警示/问题揭露/批评文。

styles.h1: font-size: 32px; font-weight: 900; color: #1F1F1F; line-height: 1.15; margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 24px; background: #FF6B00; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; border-left: 8px solid #FFD700; border-right: 8px solid #FFD700;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; color: #FF6B00; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-left: 6px solid #FF6B00; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#FFD700 0 12px,transparent 12px);
styles.h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; color: #FFD700; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 26px; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h4: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #1F1F1F; background: #FFD700; display: inline-block; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 2.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.h5: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #E8E8E8; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.4;
styles.h6: font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #999999; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #E8E8E8; line-height: 1.75; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
styles.blockquote: background: rgba(255,107,0,0.10); border: 2px solid #FF6B00; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 22px; font-size: 14px; color: #FF6B00; line-height: 1.7; font-weight: 600;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 14px; color: #FF6B00; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent; font-weight: 600;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; display: block; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; border: 4px solid #FF6B00; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 30px; height: 10px; border: none; background: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg,#FFD700 0 12px,#1F1F1F 12px 24px);
styles.code: background: rgba(255,107,0,0.15); border-radius: 0; font-size: 92%; color: #FFD700; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,monospace; border: 1px solid #FF6B00; font-weight: 600;
styles.pre: background: #141414; border: 2px solid #FF6B00; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #E8E8E8; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.65; white-space: pre-wrap;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; background: #FF6B00; color: #1F1F1F; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #E8E8E8; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','SF Mono',Menlo,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 13px; border: 2px solid #FF6B00;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 900; color: #1F1F1F; background: #FF6B00; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #E8E8E8; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.3px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
